about_the_game:
Purchase Mercenaries

Mercenaries are purchased from the Gladiator Den, their base stats are randomly allocated, and they have a random trait.

Your mercenaries get stronger as you level them up via combat, and arm them with superior equipment.

Quest Run

Quest runs are tile based battles, you are presented with a 6x13 tiled grid, tiles are most commonly battles, but can also be events which garner special items.

A key must be found to enter a hidden dungeon, completing the dungeon progresses you to the next biome.

Journey through 8 biomes, all with unique enemies to defeat.

Sewer Run

Progress deeper into the sewer, defeating enemies armed with random equipment, on each 10th level you are subjected to a boss fight.

Bookies

Place bets on gladiators fighting in the colosseum.

Casino

Use your gold in the casino for a chance to win rare items

Colosseum

Enter your mercenaries in the colosseum, to fight as gladiators

Loot

All equipment and gems have random modifiers.

There are Primary Modifiers which are identified in light blue text, and Secondary Modifiers in blue text.

Crafting

Find items to upgrade equipment.

Pearls are insertable items that are inserted into socketed equipment, they have 3 stats, only one of which will be imbued to the socketed item.

The chance of success for each stat is indicated by a percentage directly beneath the stat.

Equipment

Equip each mercenary with armour, jewellery and weapons.

All armours and weapons have thier own sprites.

short_description: Purchase mercenaries to create a party to fight monsters, angels and demons, all manner of beasts. Recover equipment from the slain to strengthen your party, upgrade your gear with rare crafting items, and level up your party whichever way you choose.
